children: Aave V4 market deposits rose to about $1.51 billion, while loans increased to about $595.5 million. According to Odaily, citing Sentora data, deposits grew from about $496.3 million on August 22 to about $1.51 billion on November 19, roughly tripling; loans rose from about $174 million to about $595.5 million, or around 3.42 times. Loans as a share of deposits increased from 35.1% to 39.4%. From November 5 to 19, loans rose 16.3% and deposits increased 13.5%. The balance changes do not show whether borrowers migrated from V3, were new to Aave, or were affected by token price fluctuations.

title: Aave V4 Deposits Rise to $1.51 Billion as Loans Reach $595.5 Million
